model_used.description: Which chat model actually generated this answer.
model_used.title: Model Used

EvalScores.description:
Phase 109 - live LLM-as-judge scores, same prompts/parsing as the
offline golden-dataset harness (golden_dataset_harness.py), run
synchronously per live response at the user's explicit request
(accepted tradeoff: 2 extra judge LLM calls per live - not cached -
generation). 0.0-1.0, not 0-10 - already normalized by the judge.

groundedness.description: Is the answer supported by the retrieved context? 0.0-1.0.
groundedness.title: Groundedness

completeness.description: Does the answer fully address the question? 0.0-1.0.
completeness.title: Completeness

EvalScores.title: EvalScores

ExplainabilityInfo.description:
Phase 107/109 - real latency/token/cache-vs-live/eval numbers,
genai-rag only. Dollar cost is deliberately excluded (see BACKLOG.md).

served_from_cache.description: True if this answer came from the answer cache, not a live retrieval+generation call.
served_from_cache.title: Served From Cache

llm_call_count.description: How many LLM calls this request made - 0 on a cache hit or MCP fast-path, 1 otherwise. Excludes eval-judge calls.
llm_call_count.title: Llm Call Count

token_usage.description: Null on a cache hit, MCP fast-path, or a no-context answer that never called the LLM.

llm_context.description: Phase 132 - genai-rag only; null for single/multi-agentic-rag and on a cache hit (nothing was actually sent this call).

routed_to.description: The MCP tool name if this answer was dynamically routed there instead of RAG (Phase 49/108). Null otherwise.
routed_to.title: Routed To

eval_scores.description: Null for an MCP answer or a no-context answer (nothing to check groundedness against). Reused as-is on a cache hit - same answer, same score, not re-judged.

temperature.description: Phase 127 - genai-rag only; null for single/multi-agentic-rag, which hardcode temperature=0, not user-configurable.
temperature.title: Temperature

ExplainabilityInfo.title: ExplainabilityInfo

total.description: Total wall-clock time for this call, in milliseconds.
total.title: Total

retrieval.description: Time spent retrieving chunks, in milliseconds. Null on a cache hit.
retrieval.title: Retrieval

generation.description: Time spent generating the answer, in milliseconds. Null on a cache hit.
generation.title: Generation

eval.description: Time spent on live eval-judge scoring, in milliseconds. Null when no eval ran this call (cache hit, MCP, or no context).
eval.title: Eval

decomposition.description: Phase 130 - genai-rag only; time spent splitting the question into sub-questions. Null elsewhere.
decomposition.title: Decomposition

LlmContextInfo.description: Phase 132 - genai-rag only (null for single/multi-agentic-rag, same pattern as temperature).
LlmContextInfo.title: LlmContextInfo

LlmContextTurn.description:
Phase 132 - one real LLM call's actual rendered prompt, not a re-derived guess -
captured from the exact same inputs the real chain.invoke() call used.

label.description: e.g. 'answer' (single question) or the sub-question text (decomposed).
label.title: Label

response.description: The raw answer text this turn's LLM call returned.
response.title: Response

LlmContextTurn.title: LlmContextTurn

McpToolCallDetail.description: Phase 132 - the raw MCP call, not just the summary ToolCallInfo already carries.

raw_result.description: The MCP tool's raw text blocks, before being joined into the answer.
raw_result.title: Raw Result

McpToolCallDetail.title: McpToolCallDetail

vector_db.description: Which vector store this query actually ran against.
vector_db.title: Vector Db

search_strategy.description: Which retrieval technique actually ran: 'similarity' or 'mmr'.
search_strategy.title: Search Strategy

applied_filter.description: The metadata filter Self-Query actually parsed out of the question, if any.
applied_filter.title: Applied Filter

sources.description: The chunks the answer was actually grounded in.
sources.title: Sources

document_id.title: Document Id

chunk_index.description: This chunk's position within that document.
chunk_index.title: Chunk Index

text.description: The chunk's text, as stored at index time.
text.title: Text

score.description: The vector store's own similarity score, null for MMR results.
score.title: Score

RetrievedChunk.title: RetrievedChunk

tool_input.description: What the agent passed to it.

tool_type.description: Phase 126 - which kind of backend this hit: vector_db/mcp/web_search/sql_db/other.
tool_type.title: Tool Type

latency_ms.description: Phase 126 - how long this one call took, if measured.

success.description: Phase 126 - false if this call returned an 'Error: ...' result.
